Debian GNOME polkit agent with the N13 approval prompt and password fallback

T8 part two, run-g1: 10 of 10 approvals of the harmless exec action (auth_admin, no keep) for the selected administrator pk-admin from a pk-test session, one request, one signer call, one verified signature each, OCR audit passed. 36 of 36 negatives and 12 of 12 recoveries, mouse Approve and Tab then Enter pass. A competing sudo while the panel is pending gets no approval prompt. A broker restart or a dead pkcheck with the panel up releases nothing. The signature binds the account and the polkit service, not the action.
Debian GNOME panel on small screens and larger text

When the panel does not fit it shows a reason and Approve stays disabled. 800 by 600: the greeter, lock screen and polkit dialog each refused A, kept Cancel and password recovery working. 1.5 times text: the lock screen clipped and refused A, the polkit dialog fit and approved. GDM at 1.5 times text and 1024 by 768 were not run. The panel overlaps the Debian logo at 1280 by 800 (cosmetic). AT-SPI shows the panel text and two named buttons for the polkit panel.

Original N23 defect reproduced with the old prompt under default ClearType. N26 forces grayscale compositor text and replaces opacity with alpha text colors without relaxing pixel checks. Final packaged Chrome and Firefox each fill 3/3 with no auto submit; Cancel empty. See R118/R119 for hashes, full regression, controlled decoy negatives and the explained mixed-run b8 artifact.
